neet_phy_u05_t06_2.working: I_cm = ML^2/12 = 3*16/12 = 4; parallel axis adds Md^2 = 3*1 = 3; total 7 kg m^2

neet_phy_u05_t06_3.working: Two diagonals are perpendicular in the plane and have equal I; their sum is I_z = Ma^2/6, so each diagonal gives Ma^2/12

neet_phy_u05_t06_4.working: Since I = I_cm + Md^2 >= I_cm, A is true. The theorem requires one axis through the CM, so R is false
